python3 - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import ast,hashlib,json,subprocess
p=Path('docs/evidence/2026-09-11-v1-06a-snapshot-provenance.json'); r=json.loads(p.read_bytes())
found={str(p) for p in Path('docs/evidence/snapshots').glob('v1-06a*.py')}
assert found=={x['path'] for x in r['snapshots']}
baseline=0
for item in r['snapshots']:
 raw=Path(item['path']).read_bytes()
 assert len(raw)==item['bytes'] and hashlib.sha256(raw).hexdigest()==item['sha256'],item['path']
 assert raw.endswith(b'\n')
 ast.parse(raw,filename=item['path'])
 if item['origin']=='preceding_committed_implementation_branch_source':
  expected=subprocess.check_output(['git','show',item['commit']+':'+item['source']])
  assert raw==expected and item['byte_exact'] is True,item['path']
  baseline+=1
 else:
  assert item['commit'] is None and item['baseline_exact_claim'] is False
nodes=lambda raw:[ast.dump(n,include_attributes=False) for n in ast.walk(ast.parse(raw)) if isinstance(n,ast.Assert)]
exact=total=0
for item in r['fixture_audits']:
 old=Path(item['snapshot']).read_bytes(); current=Path(item['source']).read_bytes()
 assert hashlib.sha256(current).hexdigest()==item['current_sha256']
 b,a=nodes(old),nodes(current)
 assert len(b)==item['before_assert_count'] and len(a)==item['after_assert_count']
 count=sum(x==y for x,y in zip(b,a))
 assert count==item['positional_exact_asserts'] and (b==a)==item['all_original_assert_ast_exact']
 assert subprocess.run(['git','cat-file','-e',r['baseline_commit']+':'+item['source']],capture_output=True).returncode!=0
 exact+=count; total+=len(b)
assert baseline==14 and len(found)==36 and total==65 and exact==64
print(json.dumps({'snapshots':len(found),'baseline_byte_exact':baseline,'draft_candidates':18,'new_fixture_versions':4,'fixture_asserts':total,'unchanged_assert_ast':exact,'explicit_new_fixture_assert_correction':1},sort_keys=True))
